title: Battle of Jigjiga (1900)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Jigjiga (1900)", at revision 1374252395, opens: "The Battle of Jigjiga was fought on March 5, 1900, between the Ethiopian Empire and the Dervish State." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q123411905, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1900 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
